instruction: Copy the AWS invoice email and the Twitter receipt email from Thunderbird's Bills folder as .eml files into my Google Drive emails folder, naming the files according to their email subjects.

expected_subjects: Amazon Web Services Invoice Available [Account: 0123456789ab] [Invoice ID: 0123456789]
